parsed.note_claim: Genetically, two white parents having twins with very dark skin is extremely unlikely unless one or both have recent mixed ancestry—rare, not impossible.

parsed.quote: Can a couple have a baby that is significantly darker or lighter than either individual? The short answer is, yes!
